She said it would only cost ¬£100.00 and I would start making money with them. I agreed on this on the 4th of March 2021. The next day she messaged me and asked for my sort code, account number, and my name on my credit card in order to pay. Then I received an email from the support that I had paid and they required me to pay more than ¬£245.00 for the maintenance. Then I got 5 more emails asking for money for different reasons. From those emails, I sent more money to them: ¬£1112 ¬£2750 ¬£2500. Then I realized I have been scammed. I tried to contact the company but it was never going through.
